target: TI CC23xx (F3, TI Drivers and BLE5-Stack)

impl.replace: MSPM0 source: one line in the force-included header maps DL_GPIO_clearPins on the LED pin to GPIO_write(CONFIG_GPIO_LED_0, CONFIG_GPIO_LED_ON).
impl.trap: The LED alias and the DriverLib LED mapping are the lines most likely to change behavior.

proof.what: 10 of 10 driver examples build; the first 5 ran on the CC2340R5

impl.replace: GPIO_CFG_HIZ_ON and GPIO_CFG_HIZ_OFF are defined as 0: F3 pins default to input with no pull.
impl.trap: A dropped flag can change behavior on a pin that was meant to float high impedance.
impl.check: read the pin level with and without a load

impl.replace: UART_open, UART_read, UART_write and ten more are renamed to the UART2_ calls, one #define each; the board names CONFIG_UART_0 and CONFIG_UART_BAUD_RATE get one line each.
impl.check: same echo as the original driver example

proof.what: uart_echo and uart_callback twins build; the first 5 of 10 apps ran

impl.replace: Start from TI's basic_ble example (SimpleLink Low Power F3 SDK 9.21.00.36) and apply one patch; the stack starts from SysConfig.
A static gattAttribute_t table (GATT_BT_ATT entries) with property bytes and permissions such as GATT_PERMIT_ENCRYPT_READ.
impl.trap: The table's value pointers are const: copy the descriptor into static storage that exists at link time.

proof.what: attribute table builds into the 193,995 B image

impl.replace: TI ships no HID over GATT service for the CC2340R5: write the service by hand (HID information, report map, control point, protocol mode, report with a report reference) on basic_ble.
impl.degrades: the link dropped 9 ms after encryption (reason 8) and did not return; no report was seen by a host
impl.check: host OS lists the device as HID and reads the report map

proof.what: macOS lists it as Compatible LE HID; pairing accepted once
gamepad report map and report on the same pattern

impl.replace: GATT_PROP_NOTIFY on the input report plus the client configuration (gattCharCfg_t); report reference id 3, type input; notify after the core packs the report.
impl.check: host receives the report bytes when subscribed

proof.what: builds; no host received a report

impl.replace: Advertising set from SysConfig (flags, appearance 0x03C0, service UUIDs 0x1812 and 0x180F, name in the scan response).
impl.check: scanner sees name, appearance and UUIDs; advertises again after a disconnect

proof.what: the Mac scan saw the advertisement; 4.1 callbacks per second
122 packets in 75 s, appearance and UUIDs as set

impl.replace: TI's dev_info_service with the same strings as the original.
impl.check: client reads the same strings as the original

proof.what: Device Information read by bleak equals the ESP32-C6's

impl.replace: Just Works pairing with GATT_PERMIT_ENCRYPT_READ on the HID attributes.
impl.trap: Two earlier pairing boxes with no click on Connect timed out after 30 s (SMP timeout).
impl.check: host pairs, link encrypted, reconnect works

proof.what: pairing accepted once, encrypted, then the link dropped

impl.replace: Display_printf(dispHandle, 0, 0, ...) on the UART display that the example's menu module opens; it adds the line end, so collect text up to each newline.
impl.check: same text on the host terminal

proof.what: MAP and RPT1 to RPT4 lines read over the console equal the C6's
